opening.argument: The material is presented as practical instruction for registering on a free Dogecoin-mining website, activating an account, and attempting to earn DOGE step by step. It expressly states that the strategy requires “zero deposit and zero investment,” while qualifying that earnings are not guaranteed and may depend on the platform, effort, and market conditions. It also warns that some platforms may change their payment systems or stop paying at any time, and the displayed warning advises viewers not to invest or deposit because such sites are risky. The separate Telegram giveaway invitation requires joining a channel, but the described material does not establish a deceptive prize, any later requirement, or any flow of money or data.
